risk.label: Volatility (1Y)
risk.why: Swings this wide test conviction in a long held for years.

risk.label: Max drawdown (1Y)

risk.label: Top customer share

risk.why: Rising receivables and investment gains push earnings past cash flow.

risk.label: Days to cover
risk.why: Crowding check for the long; short interest stays small.

valuation.why: A 10x multiple says the market expects a demand peak.

valuation.label: EV / Sales (forward)
valuation.why: Demand thesis rests on FY2028 revenue reaching the $726B consensus.

valuation.label: EV / EBITDA (LTM)
valuation.why: Prices today's profits with little credit for further growth.

valuation.label: FCF yield (after stock pay)

valuation.label: PEG
valuation.why: Shows the market doubts the 66% EPS growth analysts forecast.

valuation.label: Shareholder yield
